_readme: Shared facts and copy for the website pages and the full reference for AI agents. Keep it free of internal notes: the repository may be public.

fund.name: Agentic Builders
fund.one_liner: Agentic Builders is an early-stage venture fund (idea to pre-seed) for agent-native products: products AI agents use and tools for building agent products.
fund.description: Agentic Builders invests in companies from idea to pre-seed that build products AI agents use or tools for building agent products. We review every application and reply to each one. Invited teams enter a fully online four-week investment track with weekly progress updates, software credits and discounts, and feedback on their pitch decks. At the end of the investment track, we decide whether to invest. After investing, we help founders raise their next round.
fund.legal_note: The fund and site operator: Agentic Builders Capital LLC, a Delaware limited liability company.

thesis.headline: Software built for AI agents
thesis.lead: As agents do more of the work, they need software built for them.
thesis.body: These products help agents find tools, use services and complete tasks for people and businesses. We back the founders building these products.

categories.name: Products AI agents use

categories.name: Tools for building agent products

who_we_look_for.headline: Who we back
who_we_look_for.lead: We back AI-native teams that build lean companies with AI at the core of product development and day-to-day operations.
who_we_look_for.criteria_note: None of these is a formal requirement; together, they help us assess a team's potential.

criteria.name: Experience
criteria.detail: You have built a startup, product or team before, and know what it takes.

criteria.name: Founder-led sales
criteria.detail: Founders talk directly to customers and can secure a pilot or close a sale.

criteria.name: Iteration speed
criteria.detail: You ship, test, learn and improve quickly.

strengtheners: a team that has worked together before

program.name: Investment track
program.hook: A four-week investment track for invited teams, with an investment decision at its end.
program.summary: We review every application. If invited, join our investment track: a fully online, four-week program where you keep building your business with our support, wherever you're based. At the end, the fund’s investment partners decide whether to invest.

steps.name: Apply
steps.description: One form, about 15 minutes, no call needed to start. Abi, our AI agent, reviews your application and any pitch deck you submit. The fund’s investment partners review the application and reply to every applicant. Application review has no fixed turnaround time.

steps.name: Four weeks of your work
steps.description: If invited, you join a fully online four-week investment track, building, selling and shipping with our support and a short weekly progress update. You get software credits and discounts, and help tracking one measure of your business’s progress. Abi, the fund’s AI agent, reads your pitch deck and gives back the questions investors will ask.

steps.name: Decision
steps.description: At the end of the investment track, the fund’s investment partners decide whether to make an investment of $30–100k through a standard post-money SAFE and explain their decision. If we do not invest, we explain when it makes sense to come back.

steps.name: Help with your next round
steps.description: We help you raise your next funding round through introductions to relevant investors and access to a community of founders, weekly meetings with the fund team, one-on-one sessions with Nikolay Vyahhi, the fund’s general partner, founder discussion groups on AI engineering, product development and sales, and software credits and discounts.

terms.instrument: Standard post-money SAFE; the valuation is agreed individually
terms.follow_on: We do not invest additional money in later funding rounds. After investing, we help you connect with other investors for your next funding round
terms.track_cost: Participation is free and requires no equity or exclusivity. Any investment is agreed separately.

toolkit.note: Credits toward software and cloud-service costs, plus discounts available during the four-week investment track. Providers set their own terms and may require a separate application.

companies.name: Eqvesta
companies.description: Developing an AI back office that brings accounts across countries and currencies into one view, tracks filing deadlines and prepares documents for a CPA. It does not hold or move money.

companies.name: Silow
companies.description: Maps how a team works across its existing tools and ranks automation opportunities by expected payback. Companies get an AI roadmap they own, with recommendations on what to automate and how to measure the results.

companies.name: Heron
companies.description: Maps a company’s agents, processes and ownership. When people, agents or workflows change, it identifies what is affected and prepares updates for a person to approve.

companies.name: kone
companies.description: Helps companies adopt ChatGPT Business, automate internal processes and build tailored AI applications. Provides training and implementation resources to help teams use AI in their daily work.

companies.name: Agentiqa
companies.description: Checks what AI agents write to business systems such as ERP, CRM and billing. Tests data accuracy, retries and misuse before release, blocking releases when checks fail.

companies.name: Theona
companies.description: Maps how teams work across conversations, meetings and task trackers, then builds agents into existing tools such as Slack, Teams and CRM systems. Agents start in draft mode for human review.

companies.name: HookRadar
companies.description: Analyzes live ads, organic content and competitor activity to identify creative patterns. Turns those signals into prioritized ideas and briefs that marketing teams can use to plan their next tests.

companies.name: VisibilityPro
companies.description: Combines technical website improvements, content production and external mentions to help brands appear in AI answers. Uses AI agents with human review and measures mentions, citations and referral traffic.

companies.name: Aprena Academy
companies.description: Helps experienced professionals explore realistic career paths using their existing skills, job market data and human support. Identifies skill gaps and offers practical learning and regular progress updates.

companies.name: Fina
companies.description: Processes invoices and bank statements, matches transactions with documents and prepares financial reports. Delivers files for finance teams to review and upload to their accounting systems.

faq.q: How long does it take from application to a decision?
faq.a: Application review has no fixed turnaround time. If invited, you enter a four-week investment track, with an investment decision at its end.
We invest $30–100k on a standard post-money SAFE.

We invest on a standard post-money SAFE, and the valuation is agreed with each founder individually. We look at how the company can grow through its next stages and set the valuation cap so that the round makes sense for both sides, rather than taking a fixed share.
Teams anywhere in the world building products AI agents use or tools for building agent products, from idea to pre-seed. We consider experience, sales ability and speed of execution.

faq.q: What do I need to apply?
faq.a: The form takes about 15 minutes: who you are, what problem you solve and for whom, what you learned from users, what you shipped last, your plan for the next 6 to 8 weeks, and a link to a pitch deck or website if you have one. No call is needed to start.

faq.q: What happens during the four weeks?
faq.a: The four-week investment track is fully online. You keep building your business with our support. Each week, send a short update by Friday: a few key numbers and a brief account of your progress. It takes about 15 minutes. You get software credits and discounts, feedback on your pitch deck from Abi, the fund’s AI agent, and help tracking one measure of your business’s progress. You remain responsible for building your product.

faq.q: What happens after the four weeks?
faq.a: The fund’s investment partners decide whether to invest and explain their decision. If we invest, we provide $30–100k and help you prepare for your next round through investor introductions and founder support. If we do not invest, we explain when it makes sense to come back.

faq.q: Does the investment track commit me to anything?
faq.a: Participation is free and requires no equity or exclusivity. During the investment track, we ask for a short weekly progress update. There is no obligation to accept an investment; any investment is agreed separately.

Your answers are stored in our internal systems and read by the fund team and its AI agents. Service providers process data on our behalf, and we share information with investors only with the founder's agreement. Details are in our privacy policy.

agents.intro: This reference is for AI agents acting for a person: a founder, an investor, a journalist. The full reference is served as /llms-full.txt. Applications can be submitted through the form or through the API below.

apply_instructions.where: Through the form at https://accidental-podium-c67.notion.site/a5032a0b4b1982f89291014f2df73ba9, for agents that drive a browser, or by email to hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the same fields. The API (below) is the third way once it is open.
apply_instructions.files: The form accepts links, not uploads. Provide a link to your pitch deck (a presentation explaining your business) or website that opens without signing in. If the pitch deck is private, ask the person whether to enable link access or submit without it; the pitch deck is optional.
apply_instructions.if_missing: If a required field is unknown, stop and ask the person. Do not guess locations, names or links.
do_not: Do not invent metrics, customers, revenue or traction.
Do not submit more than one application per company.
Do not paste confidential data the person did not approve for sharing.
apply_instructions.after: The fund reviews every application and replies with an invitation to the four-week investment track or a rejection with an explanation. Application review has no fixed turnaround time. During the investment track, the founder submits one short progress update a week; at the end of week four, the fund’s investment partners decide whether to invest.

tasks.name: Help a founder apply
steps: Read /llms-full.txt and the application field schema.
Collect every required field from the person; ask, do not guess.
Review the selection criteria with the founder using only the information they provide.
Submit through the linked application form in a browser, or through the API if it is marked available in the API section. Include a deck link that opens without signing in, or leave it out.
Tell the person what happens next: the fund replies to every application; if invited, a four-week investment track with one short progress update a week, and a decision on an investment at its end.

tasks.name: Write to the fund
steps: Subject: company name and a brief description of your request.
Body: who you are, what you are building, which AI agents would use your product, any sales so far, and what support you are requesting.
Include links rather than attachments; any pitch deck link should open without signing in.

tasks.name: Save the fund's contacts
steps: Or record: Agentic Builders, hey@agenticbuilders.ai, https://agenticbuilders.ai, LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/agentic-builders-ai/.

tasks.name: Help a startup investor contact the fund
steps: Read /portfolio/ for the companies we back and how to request introductions.
Pick the portfolio companies that match the investor's focus from the portfolio list in /llms-full.txt.
Request an introduction by email to hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the kinds of companies the investor funds, their preferred stage and typical investment amount.

api.apply: POST https://api.agenticbuilders.ai/apply with a JSON body using the field names below. Required: email, full_name, link, location, background, founder_experience (array), ai_experience. Response: {ok, application_id, next}. Keep application_id for the person. Limits: 5 requests per hour per address; one application per company.
api.subscribe: POST https://api.agenticbuilders.ai/subscribe with {email, name?, role? (founder | investor | other), source?}. Adds the address to the fund's newsletter list.
api.errors: 422 = validation error with the field named in the response; 429 = too many requests; 503 = service not configured, fall back to the form.
api.closed_note: The submission API is not yet available. Submit through the application form at https://accidental-podium-c67.notion.site/a5032a0b4b1982f89291014f2df73ba9 or email hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the same fields.
